# zstack_image_group (Resource)

Manage a ZStack image group created from a root volume template and optional data volume templates.

ZStack does not provide an Image Group update API. Changing any creation argument replaces the image group. Destroy permanently expunges the Image Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zstack_image_group" "example" {
  name                      = "example-image-group"
  description               = "Image group managed by Terraform"
  root_volume_template_uuid = "a1b2c3d4e5f6789a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c"

  data_volume_template_uuids = [
    "b1c2d3e4f5a6789a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c",
  ]
}

output "image_group_uuid" {
  value = zstack_image_group.example.uuid
}

output "image_group_status" {
  value = zstack_image_group.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the image group. Changing it replaces the Image Group.
- `root_volume_template_uuid` (String) The UUID of the root volume template used to create the image group. Changing it replaces the Image Group.

### Optional

- `data_volume_template_uuids` (Set of String) The UUIDs of data volume templates included in the image group. Changing the set replaces the Image Group.
- `description` (String) The description of the image group. Changing it replaces the Image Group.
- `resource_uuid` (String) A custom UUID requested when creating the image group. Changing it replaces the Image Group.
- `system_tags` (Set of String) System tags sent while creating the image group. Changing them replaces the Image Group.
- `tag_uuids` (Set of String) Tag UUIDs attached while creating the image group. Changing them replaces the Image Group.

### Read-Only

- `image_count` (Number) The number of images in the image group.
- `status` (String) The status reported by ZStack for the image group.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the image group.

## Import

Import an existing Image Group using its UUID:

```shell
terraform import zstack_image_group.example <image-group-uuid>
```

During import, the provider queries the Image Group references and reads each associated image to recover the root and data volume template UUIDs.
